title: White House negotiating voluntary pre-release standards with frontier labs
summary: The FT and Reuters reported the administration is in talks with AI companies, including Google, on a voluntary framework implementing the June 2 executive order: classified benchmarks for 'covered frontier models' and a 30-day pre-release review.
reason: Talks only; would formalise government evaluation of frontier models.

title: Record $510B global VC in H1 2026; OpenAI and Anthropic took 43%
summary: Crunchbase data showed record startup funding in H1 2026, with OpenAI and Anthropic alone absorbing $217B; Fortune reported Anthropic's $47B run-rate now exceeds OpenAI's revenue.
reason: Capital concentrating in two frontier labs.

title: OpenAI floats giving US government a 5% stake
summary: Fortune reported OpenAI has proposed a roughly $42.6B government stake and deeper Pentagon ties as part of a US-led AI strategy.
reason: Proposal for state-lab fusion; words only.

title: New York requires labels on ads using AI-generated performers
summary: New York became the first state to require disclosure of synthetic performers in advertising, with fines for violations.
